def g(di,bg):

    import itertools

                # extend both ends along this diagonal
                rr,cc=s[0]-dr,s[1]-dc

    bg=g[0][0]

    for col,ps in groups.items():
        vals=procs[order](ps)

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    state=[row[:] for row in g]; orig=[row[:] for row in g]
    def runs_of(state,col):
        pts={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if state[r][c]==col}
        res=[]; seen=set(); cur=None
        for p in pts:
            if p in seen: continue
            stack=[p]; cells={p}
            while stack:
                q=stack.pop()
                for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
                    t=(q[0]+dr,q[1]+dc)
                    if t in pts and t not in cells: cells.add(t); stack.append(t)
            seen|=cells
            # get a linear chain through these cells along one diag type
            best=None
            for s in cells:
                chain=[]
                nxt=None
                for t in list(cells)-{s}:
                    d2=t[0]-s[0],t[1]-s[1]
                    if abs(d2[0])==abs(d2[1]) and d2[0]/max(abs(d2)) in (1,-1) and d2!=(0,0):
                        chain=[s,t]; break
                best=chain if best is None or len(chain)>len(best) else best
            # greedy walk longest run
            cur=s; end=p
            while True:
                cands=[t for t in cells-{cur} if abs(t[0]-cur[0])==1 and abs(t[1]-cur[1])==1]
                if not cands: break
                nxt=max(cands,key=lambda t:sum(1 for x in cells if abs(x[0]-t[0])==1 and abs(x[1]-t[1])==1))
                chain.append(nxt); cur=nxt
                if any(not(0<=x[0]<H and 0<=x[1]<W) for x in [nxt]): break
                if abs(cur[0]-orig)==0: pass
            return None
        return []
    # simpler explicit per-diag line approach with blocking on ORIGINAL non-bg only, painting iteratively
    for _ in range(4):
        cand=set()
        for col in set(v for row in state for v in row)-{bg}:
            pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if state[r][c]==col]
            from collections import defaultdict
            m=defaultdict(list); a=defaultdict(list)
            for r,c in pts:
                m[(r-c)].append((r,c)); a[(r+c)].append((r,c))
            for k,v in m.items():
                if len(v)>=2:
                    # extension beyond min/max along main diag
                    lo,hi=min(v),max(v)
                    d=(1,1)
                    while True:
                        n_=(lo[0]-1,lo[1]-1)
                        if not(0<=n_[0]<H and 0<=n_[1]<W) or orig[n_[0]][n_[1]]!=bg: break
                        lo,n_=n_
                        cand.add((state[lo[0]][lo[1]],*lo))
                        d=(-1,-1)
                        break
                    hi_=(hi[0]+1,hi[1]+1)
                    while True:
                        n_=(hi_[0]+1,hi_[1]+1)
                        if not(0<=n_[0]<H and 0<=n_[1]<W) or orig[n_[0]][n_[1]]!=bg: break
                        hi_,n_=n_
                        cand.add((state[hi_[0]][hi_[1]],*hi_))
                    break
            for k,v in a.items():
                if len(v)>=2:
                    v=sorted(v)
                    lo,hi=v[0],v[-1]
                    # up-right
                    n_=(lo[0]-1,lo[1]+1)
                    while True:
                        n_=(n_[0]-1,n_[1]+1)
                        if not(0<=n_[0]<H and 0<=n_[1]<W) or orig[n_[0]][n_[1]]!=bg: break
                        lo,n_=n_
                        cand.add((state[lo[0]][lo[1]],*lo))
                    n_=(hi[0]+1,hi[1]-1)
                    while True:
                        n_=(n_[0]+1,n_[1]-1)
                        if not(0<=n_[0]<H and 0<=n_[1]<W) or orig[n_[0]][n_[1]]!=bg: break
                        hi_,n_=n_
                        cand.add((state[hi_[0]][hi_[1]],*hi_))
                    break
        if not cand: break
        for col,r,c in cand:
            if state[r][c]==bg: state[r][c]=col
    return state

from collections import Counter
def ext_fill(out,col,d,e,H,W,bg):
    n=0;cur=e
    while True:
        nr,nc=cur[0]+d[0],cur[1]+d[1]
        if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W) or out[nr][nc]!=bg: break
        out[nr][nc]=col;n+=1;cur=(nr,nc)
    return n
def f7(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]; cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    for col in [c for c in cnt if c!=bg and cnt[c]>=2]:
        pts=[(r,c_) for r in range(H) for c_ in range(W) if out[r][c_]==col]
        sortedp=sorted(pts)
        best=None
        for d in ((1,1),(1,-1),(0,1)):
            diffs=[(sortedp[i+1][0]-sortedp[i][0],sortedp[i+1][1]-sortedp[i][1]) for i in range(len(sortedp)-1)]
            if not all(diff==(d[0],d[1]) for diff in diffs): continue
            def prj(p): return p[0]*d[0]+p[1]*d[1]
            e_lo=min(pts,key=prj); e_hi=max(pts,key=prj)

from collections import Counter
def solve(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    cnt=Counter(v for r in I for v in r)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    mks=[(i,j) for c,vv in cnt.items() if vv==1 and c!=bg for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==c]
    def dist(p,q): return abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1])
    for c,vv in cnt.items():
        if c==bg or vv<2: continue
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==c]
        mkm=min(mks,key=lambda q:min(dist((p[0],p[1]),q) for p in cells))
        tip=max(cells,key=lambda p:dist(p,mkm))
        dr=(tip[0]>mkm[0])-(tip[0]<mkm[0]); dc=(tip[1]>mkm[1])-(tip[1]<mkm[1])
        if (dr,dc)==(0,0): continue
        na,nb=tip[0]+dr,tip[1]+dc
        while 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and O[na][nb]==bg:
            O[na][nb]=c; na+=dr; nb+=dc
    return O
for k in ['Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
out=solve(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))

    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    cnt=Counter(v for r in I for v in r)

        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==c]
        mkm=min(mks,key=lambda q:min(dist((p[0],p[1]),q) for p in cells))
        tip=max(cells,key=lambda p:dist(p,mkm))
        dr=(tip[0]>mkm[0])-(tip[0]<mkm[0]); dc=(tip[1]>mkm[1])-(tip[1]<mkm[1])
        if (dr,dc)==(0,0): continue
        na,nb=tip[0]+dr,tip[1]+dc
        while 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and O[na][nb]==bg:
            O[na][nb]=c; na+=dr; nb+=dc
    return O
